name: Nano Electronics and Micro System Technologies, Inc.
summary: Nano Electronics and Micro System Technologies, Inc. engages in the research and development, design, manufacture, marketing, sale, and technical service support of dry plasma surface treatment equipment. It offers vacuum products, such as plasma cleaners, desmears, and ashers; and DBD wide type, arc and RF jet type, and corona type atmospheric plasma cleaners. It serves the semiconductor and PCB industries. The company was founded in 1999 and is based in Tainan City, Taiwan.
